scope.claim: Test whether one width-specific tree chosen once by aggregating the frozen K8/B3 score over representative calibration inputs can be reused on unseen wide-range inputs with zero online selection work.
scope.motivation: The validated per-input selector improves ranking but costs 68 full-tree-equivalent traversals, so this stage tests an offline deployment contract rather than tuning another score.
not_claimed: that FP32 tree selection beats higher-precision accumulation

frozen_lineage.score: fixed K8 root-band Q, shortlist four, B3 joint cell beam
frozen_lineage.score_tuning: none; no K8/B3 parameter or model coefficient may change in this stage
frozen_lineage.v2_heldout_use: implementation/model provenance only; no v2 held-out input, graph, target, or aggregate label selects the offline policy

input_seeds.separation: all derived seeds must be unique, calibration and confirmation must be disjoint, and neither split may overlap v1/v2 held-out seeds

offline_policy.per_input_complete_rank: K8/B3 shortlist members occupy ranks 0..3 ordered by beam score; all remaining candidates follow in Q-score order; all ties use graph index
offline_policy.aggregation: choose the graph with minimum mean complete cascade rank over the first r calibration inputs; ties use graph index
offline_policy.q_static_baseline: minimum mean Q rank over all 32 calibration inputs
offline_policy.oracle_static_ceiling: minimum mean within-input normalized regret over all 32 calibration inputs; uses labels and is not a deployable label-free policy
offline_policy.no_confirmation_adaptation: no graph, representative count, aggregation, threshold, or gate may change after confirmation begins

direct_methods: sequential FP64 accumulation then FP32 cast
confirmation_baselines.reference: correctly rounded FP32 value of the exact rational input sum
confirmation_baselines.warning: Python measurements are not used to claim target-hardware speed; operation/pass contracts are compared instead

target.candidate_ranking: squared signed forward error in exact-sum root-ULP units; smaller is better
target.normalized_regret: (target - candidate-catalog minimum)/(candidate-catalog maximum - minimum), or zero if all candidates tie
target.direct_method_quality: squared error, absolute error, and correctly-rounded-output hit relative to the exact rational sum

metrics.primary: paired random-fixed-catalog expected normalized regret minus score_static_r32 normalized regret
metrics.positive_evidence_rule: the lower endpoint of the 95% width-stratified input bootstrap interval is greater than zero
metrics.balanced_gate: the lower endpoint for balanced-FP32 squared error minus score_static_r32 squared error is greater than zero
metrics.oracle_ceiling_gate: the lower endpoint for balanced-FP32 squared error minus oracle_static_r32 squared error is greater than zero
metrics.deployment_go: both the primary reuse-signal rule and balanced gate pass
secondary: best-tier hit, mean and p90 normalized regret, and severe-regret rate
mean/p90 squared root-ULP error and mean absolute root-ULP error
per-input score winner concentration and normalized entropy

online_cost_contract.score_static_execution: one selected FP32 tree: n-1 FP32 additions
online_cost_contract.balanced_execution: one fixed FP32 tree: n-1 FP32 additions
online_cost_contract.per_input_K8_B3: 68 score-side full-tree-equivalent traversals plus execution of one selected tree
online_cost_contract.fp64_then_fp32: one pass of FP64 additions plus one FP32 cast
online_cost_contract.kahan_fp32: one pass with multiple FP32 operations and a compensation state
online_cost_contract.offline_cost: 32 K8/B3 selections per width, paid once and excluded from online inference

opening.required_worktree: clean committed worktree containing this preregistration
opening.overwrite: forbidden; a complete or partial directory blocks execution
opening.stopping_rule: all 32 calibration and 64 confirmation inputs at every width must complete; no early stopping
